programme.basis: Relative calendar days with independent road teams and two-end launcher pairs. Each road team reserves one casting yard and each deck job reserves two terminal yards. Terminal yards are relocated by work package and the model retains mobilisation and site setup for every package. The held day/night and foundation-release scenarios, road permits and stock schedules require contractor evidence. The finish is a standard-deck handover envelope. Opening requires other programmes.

standard_stock_materials.basis: Recurring 20 m stock and spread footing trial only. Match supports and lift geometry to surveys.

water_screen.basis: Geometry screen on retained mapped water polygons. Short canals, parallel basins, bridge length, approaches, high water and pier clearance require separate survey.

crew_shifts.role: Haul driver for loaded round trip

workforce.labour_basis: Crew availability covers posts and paid shift hours. Gantry payroll is priced once in erection, road labour in operated plant and haul, casting labour in fabrication, and indicative standard support and permanent track labour in their works allowances. Support and track figures transfer outline productivity assumptions. Station, utility, special-crossing, testing and operations crews require separate contractor or operator workplans.

cost.basis: Constant 2026 USD planning allowances. Fleet follows the 18-hour, six-minute service offer; take-up and timetable capacity need operating evidence. Construction funding dates are open.
open_scopes: Timetable conflicts, fleet rotations, depot connections and capacity
Utility connections, electrical protection and grid failure cases
Station and special civil designs, property access and coordinated systems labour

assumptions.assignment_basis: Shortest generalised cost among paths with zero to two inter-line changes, including street access and egress. Equal costs prefer fewer changes.
assumptions.scope: Rail trips with walking access. Relative demand and segment shares require local trip data and timetable evidence to establish passenger counts and capacity.
assumptions.service_basis: Simulated bidirectional all-stops rail with continuous headways. Running train-km exclude depot and turnback movements.

street_source.scope: Step-excluded walking estimate; ordinary roads without sidewalks can remain. No wheelchair-passability or safe-crossing certificate.

assumptions.waiting_basis: Each boarding waits half its directional headway. Transfer walk counts as elapsed time and the transfer penalty contributes to generalised cost.
assumptions.walking_eligibility_basis: Each endpoint has a feasible directed street walk to or from at least one station within the walking and snap limits.
assumptions.weight_basis: Origin population share multiplied by the assigned centre destination share. All networks use these same ordered pairs and weights.
assumptions.witness_basis: For each observed transfer count, use the assigned path for the highest-weight pair.

assumptions.demand_basis: Common synthetic population-weighted OD pairs and exponential distance decay.
assumptions.load_basis: Synthetic OD share multiplied by the ratio of a route's headway to the reference headway.
assumptions.ring_usage_basis: A journey uses M09 or M15 if its least-generalised-cost path traverses at least one directed segment of that route. Both-ring journeys traverse a segment of each route. Alignment closure is recorded for each variant.
assumptions.service_basis: Continuous bidirectional all-stop service, half-headway waits and equal running train-km. The ring frequency increase is paid for by a uniform proportional frequency reduction on the other routes. Depot moves and turnaround work are excluded.

street_source.scope: Step-excluded walking estimate; ordinary roads without sidewalks can remain. No wheelchair-passability or safe-crossing certificate.
